verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature for conversations, history, artifacts or settings. The nearest items are adjacent: a Gemini CLI migration flow that imports into Antigravity, skills stored as SKILL.md folders, and headless machine-readable output. None of these is a first-party 'export all my data and leave' capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
